environment.description: Same Tomcat 9.0 application on ECS Fargate behind the same ALB configuration. The PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance uses a DIFFERENT connection role 'report_reader_fenced' configured via RDS IAM authentication (rds_iam extension). The pg_hba.conf entry for this role specifies 'hostssl all report_reader_fenced 10.0.0.0/16 md5'. The role has been created with: CREATE ROLE report_reader_fenced LOGIN; ALTER ROLE report_reader_fenced SET statement_timeout = '5s'; GRANT SELECT ON reports TO report_reader_fenced; -- metadata table only. Data tables are accessed through a security-barrier VIEW 'report_data_view' with row-level security policies enforcing tenant isolation. Critically, the role has NO direct SELECT grant on any underlying data tables — it can only read through the view. Additionally, the role is configured with: ALTER ROLE report_reader_fenced SET plan_cache_mode = 'force_custom_plan'; The RDS instance has the pgaudit extension enabled with pgaudit.log = 'all' for this role, and a pg_stat_statements.max = 1000 with pg_stat_statements.track = 'all'. The RDS parameter group sets log_min_duration_statement = 0 for full query logging to CloudWatch.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14.9 on RDS with pgaudit + pg_stat_statements
config.row_level_security: enabled on underlying tables, enforced through security-barrier view
config.alb_rules: default action: forward to target group
